patterns.name: Review before write
patterns.summary: The agent proposes a diff and waits for approval before writing.
patterns.effect: Every write becomes a two-step exchange; nothing lands unseen.

patterns.name: One change per run
patterns.summary: A run touches a single module or file group, then stops.
patterns.effect: Keeps diffs reviewable and makes a failed run cheap to discard.

patterns.name: Test before propose
patterns.summary: The test suite must pass before a diff is offered.
patterns.effect: Adds a verification step and reports the failure instead of the diff when it breaks.

patterns.name: Approval for shell
patterns.summary: Each shell command is presented for approval before it runs.
patterns.effect: Turns the shell permission from a grant into a per-command decision.

patterns.name: Read only
patterns.summary: The agent may read the workspace but never write to it.
patterns.effect: Removes write tools from the agent entirely; findings arrive as notes.

patterns.name: Report findings
patterns.summary: Results arrive as a structured list of findings with file and line.
patterns.effect: Makes output reviewable and comparable between runs.
